thread:
Maya: quick heads-up: vendor BlackHarbor booked for pen-test 2026-11-02 -> 2026-11-04. We need owners for ephemeral RBAC, KMS scoping for evidence blobs, audit snapshot/export, remediation tracker, and retest coordination. Volunteers?

Devon: I can take RBAC. Staging + preprod only. Will create ephemeral assessor roles with permission boundaries and 6h TTL. No prod access.

Asha: I'll handle audit + KMS. Plan: CloudTrail export at start and end, include STS:AssumeRole and IAM events. Bump retention for this engagement to 120 days and enable debug auth logs during window.

Oliver: I'll run the remediation board and block retest slots. Tentative retest dates: 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-23 (2-week buffer). I'll add labels pt-sev1/2/3 and a column awaiting-retest.

Devon: IAM PR sketch (will open):
`aws iam create-role --role-name blackharbor-assessor-staging --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json`
Attach inline policy: s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject on pen-test-ingest prefix and kms:Decrypt scoped to alias/blackharbor-evidence. Enforce MFA in trust policy.

Maya: KMS alias: alias/blackharbor-evidence. No cross-account grants. Prefer vendor-side encryption + presigned uploads; do not share keys.

Asha: will create snapshot bucket s3://redwood-audit/blackharbor/ with SSE-KMS alias/blackharbor-audit. Bucket policy limited to ephemeral roles + audit group. Will include manifest template for chain-of-custody.

Security Oncall: escalation procedure: if vendor reports an exploitable SEV1, open channel #incident-pt-blackharbor and page oncall. Target ack <= 15m.

Oliver: retest eligibility draft: 1) fix merged and deployed to staging, 2) regression checks pass, 3) evidence artifacts (logs/screens) uploaded to S3 with manifest, 4) triage owner sign-off. I'll post this on the board and make it gating for scheduling.

Devon: prefer presigned PUT flow for vendor uploads. Example: `s3.getSignedUrlPromise('putObject', { Bucket, Key, Expires: 3600 })` — vendor uploads ciphertext client-side.

Asha: manifest template will include uploader, object_key, kms_key_alias, uploaded_at, and sha256. We'll store manifests under pen-test-ingest/YYYYMMDD/ and keep a manifest index for auditors.

ci-bot: PR #914 created: iam/ephemeral-blackharbor + bucket policy. CI checks: all green :white_check_mark:

Maya: owners recap: RBAC=Devon, KMS/audit=Asha, Remediation/Retest=Oliver, Incident=Security Oncall. Legal: need NDA/DPA sign-off with explicit KMS constraint. @Legal can you expedite?

Legal: acknowledged — will review; request explicit retention clause and KMS constraint in vendor agreement. Should be able to return EOD.

Devon: role TTL 6h, enforced by lambda that revokes sessions. Permission boundary will limit S3 prefix and deny kms:ReEncrypt and kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext.

Oliver: calendar invites created for retest slots. If vendor requests earlier retest, we can add an ad-hoc slot but prefer 10 business days for verification.

Asha: runbook upload plan: s3://redwood-internal/pt-runbooks/blackharbor-202611 with CloudTrail export commands, Athena snippets for STS/IAM anomalies, and archive steps t+30d.

Security Oncall: operational constraint reminder — NO SSH access to hosts. Provide jumpbox recordings or session recordings for live interaction requests.

Maya: final pre-handshake checklist: 1) RBAC PR merged + docs (Devon), 2) Audit runbook uploaded (Asha), 3) Remediation board live + retest slots (Oliver), 4) NDA signed (Legal), 5) Incident channel created (Security Oncall). I'll do vendor handshake once green.

Devon: opening PR now and will tag @Maya for review. Trust policy will require MFA and restrict principal by vendor account.

Oliver: adding gating checklist to the pt board and will require evidence artifacts before retest booking.

Asha: will also include an audit manifest verification script for triage owners to validate sha256 and kms alias.

Maya: thanks team. Post updates here and I'll consolidate a one-pager with links and manifest template before handshake. Cheers :rocket:
